# Patiya UI

> Beautiful, accessible React components built with Tailwind CSS. 50+ free copy-paste components including buttons, modals, sliders, carousels, shimmer effects, dock, and AI interfaces.

Patiya UI is a modern, lightweight React component library designed for physics-based micro-interactions, hardware-accelerated animations, and native Tailwind CSS v4 support.

- Docs: https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs
- GitHub: https://github.com/Ajay-Katariya08/patiya-ui
- Package: bun add patiya / npm i patiya

## Getting Started
- [Installation](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs): How to install and set up Patiya UI with Tailwind CSS v4.

## Elements
- [Button](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/button): Interactive button component with variants, loading state, and sizes.
- [Badge](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/badge): Small status descriptor and count badges.
- [Spinner](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/spinner): SVG loading indicator spinner.

## Forms
- [Input](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/input): Text field inputs with prefix, suffix, and error states.
- [Textarea](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/textarea): Multi-line textarea inputs.
- [Switch](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/switch): Toggle switch control.
- [Checkbox](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/checkbox): Form checkbox inputs.
- [Radio](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/radio): Radio buttons and radio groups.
- [Select](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/select): Dropdown selection menu.
- [Slider](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/slider): Range slider inputs.

## Feedback
- [Alert](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/alert): Feedback alert banners.
- [Progress](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/progress): Determinate and indeterminate progress bars.
- [Skeleton](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/skeleton): Shimmering skeleton content placeholder.

## Overlays
- [Modal](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/modal): Accessible dialog modal overlays.
- [Drawer](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/drawer): Sliding sheet drawer panels.
- [Tooltip](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/tooltip): Hover and focus floating tooltips.
- [Popover](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/popover): Floating interactive popover panels.
- [Dropdown Menu](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/dropdown-menu): Contextual dropdown menus.
- [Toast](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/toast): Stacked notifications with toast provider.

## Data Display
- [Card](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/card): Container card with header, body, and footer.
- [Avatar](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/avatar): User profile images and fallbacks.
- [Chip](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/chip): Compact dismissible chips and tags.
- [Table](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/table): Semantic styled data tables.
- [Timeline](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/timeline): Vertical chronological timeline.
- [Stepper](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/stepper): Multi-step progress tracker.

## Interactive & Physics
- [Dock](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/dock): Proximity-scaling macOS style dock.
- [Spotlight Card](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/spotlightCard): Radial spotlight tracking cursor coordinates.
- [Tilt Card](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/tiltCard): 3D perspective tilt effect on hover.
- [Flip Card](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/flipCard): Interactive 3D flip card.
- [Shimmer Button](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/shimmerButton): Conic gradient laser shimmer button.
- [Magnetic](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/magnetic): Physics magnetic cursor attraction.
- [Pointer Follower](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/pointerFollower): Custom mouse cursor follower and badges.
- [Confetti](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/confetti): Canvas confetti fireworks effect.
- [Scratch To Reveal](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/scratchToReveal): Interactive scratch-off revelation surface.
- [Direction Aware Hover](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/directionAwareHover): Overlay revealing from hover entry direction.

## Backgrounds & Effects
- [Border Beam](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/borderBeam): Animated laser border beam outline.
- [Spotlight](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/spotlight): Ambient spotlight lighting effect.
- [Meteor Shower](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/meteorShower): Animated meteor shower streaks background.
- [Aurora Background](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/auroraBackground): Soft flowing ambient aurora waves.
- [Sparkles](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/sparkles): Dynamic particle sparkles field.

## Text Effects
- [Gradient Text](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/gradientText): Animated gradient clipping typography.
- [Typing Text](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/typingText): Terminal typewriter text effect.
- [Flip Text](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/flipText): 3D rotating character flip transitions.
- [Blur Text](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/blurText): Progressive blur-in reveal typography.

## AI Interfaces
- [Prompt Input](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/promptInput): Auto-resizing textarea with submit and actions.
- [Chat Bubble](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/chatBubble): Conversational message bubbles.
- [Typing Indicator](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/typingIndicator): Pulsing AI typing dots indicator.
- [Thinking Process](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/thinkingProcess): Expandable reasoning and thought disclosure.
- [Typewriter Text](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/typewriterText): Token streaming typewriter text.
- [Prompt Suggestion](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/promptSuggestion): Clickable prompt starter pills.

## Auth & Security
- [OTP Input](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/otpInput): Segmented one-time password pin input.
- [Password Strength](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/passwordStrength): Dynamic password complexity meter.
- [Social Login Button](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/socialLoginButton): Brand-styled OAuth login buttons.
- [User Button](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/userButton): User account profile avatar menu.
- [Security Badge](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/securityBadge): Cryptographic status and compliance badge.
- [Passkey Auth](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/passkeyAuth): WebAuthn passkey biometric prompt.
- [Active Sessions](https://patiya-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/activeSessions): Manage active device sessions.
